answer: No. Your records show lisinopril 10 mg was stopped on September 22, 2025 because it gave you a dry cough, and Dr. Marsh switched you to losartan 50 mg daily. Your cough had cleared by the December 2025 visit. Lisinopril is also on your allergy/intolerance list for that cough. The app that still lists it is most likely out of date, and one hospital export from early 2025 still showed it as active, which was before the change. Your current blood pressure medicines in the records are losartan and amlodipine 5 mg, and the records also show hydrochlorothiazide was added in December 2025. Hydrochlorothiazide was then stopped in March 2026 during a hospital stay for low sodium, but your May 2026 patient-reported list and a June 2026 plan of care still seem to include it. It would be worth asking Dr. Marsh to confirm that one. Please don't restart lisinopril on your own. Ask the app's source to remove it, and bring your current medicine list to your next visit.
